text: For wurtzite ZnS, PBE calculations give a band gap of 2.1 eV, HSE06 gives 3.45 eV, and diffuse reflectance measurements on our nanopowders show an optical band gap of 3.55 eV.

gold.evidence: PBE calculations give a band gap of 2.1 eV

text: Sb2S3 thin films annealed at 300 °C show an absorption edge at 885 nm, giving the band gap of the film. The film thickness is 250 nm and the carrier lifetime is 4 ns.

Layered ReS2 flakes were exfoliated onto SiO2/Si substrates and identified by optical contrast. Raman spectroscopy shows the characteristic modes of the distorted 1T structure, and the flakes are 3 to 10 layers thick.
The fundamental gap of monolayer WS2 from scanning tunneling spectroscopy is 2.4 eV, while the A-exciton optical gap seen in absorption of the same sample is 2.0 eV.

gold.evidence: fundamental gap of monolayer WS2 from scanning tunneling spectroscopy is 2.4 eV
optical gap seen in absorption of the same sample is 2.0 eV

text: In LiNbO3 single crystals the absorption edge lies at 320 nm, and a GGA+U calculation of the same crystal yields a band gap of 3.5 eV, although literature values for the congruent composition scatter around 3.9 eV.

gold.evidence: yields a band gap of 3.5 eV
